    import collections

    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    index = 0
    t = int(input[index])
    index += 1
    results = []
    for _ in range(t):
        n = int(input[index])
        index += 1
        a = list(map(int, input[index:index + n]))
        index += n
        count = collections.Counter()
        total_weight = 0
        current_sum = 0
        for i in range(n):
            current_sum += count[a[i]]
            count[a[i]] += 1
            total_weight += current_sum
        results.append(total_weight)
    print('\n'.join(map(str, results)))
